---
title: "How do I plot values across dates or ordered time points?"
---

## What the question asks

How do I plot values across dates or ordered time points?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Sort observations by timestamp.

2. Plot with type='b' or type='l'.

3. Label the time axis and the measurement units.

## Runnable example

```{r}
days <- as.Date("2026-01-01") + 0:6
temperature_c <- c(2,4,3,6,7,5,4)
plot(days,temperature_c,type="b",pch=19,col="#3F78A8",
     xlab="Date",ylab="Temperature (C)",
     main="Week of measurements")
grid(col="gray85")
```

## Interpret the result

The line connects readings in chronological order. A visible rise over some days does not establish a long-term trend.

## Check before applying to real data

Do not imply equal time intervals when dates are irregular. Missing periods should not be invented.
